name: Giant Recruit
description: A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor.

abilities.name: Minion (7)
abilities.description: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
